Put together, these golf swing tips show you how to hit driver straight down the middle and how to hit driver farther, with a draw in place of a weak fade. If you leave this video without trying the lead arm only drill, you're leaving a square clubface and more distance off the tee on the table.

Medverkande: 

Henrik Petré, Partner, Cyber Security, PwC Sverige 

Fotis Sofronis, Director, Cybersecurity & Digital Trust, PwC Greece och EMEA Microsoft Cybersecurity Leader 

Armagan Zaloglu, CEO, Cynode

✔ AI-säkerhet och styrning 
✔ Datasäkerhet i AI-lösningar 
✔ Modern Security Operations (SOC) 
✔ Threat Detection & Response 
✔ Cyberresiliens och incidenthantering 

Tillsammans med Microsoft och Cynode hjälper PwC organisationer att hantera risker, stärka säkerheten och skapa förutsättningar för en trygg och ansvarsfull användning av AI.

Henrik Petré, Partner, Cyber Security, PwC Sweden

Armagan Zaloglu, CEO, Cynode

Together with Microsoft and Cynode, PwC helps organisations manage risk, strengthen security and enable the secure and responsible use of AI.

videos.title: 04.11.26 - RIFT Training Day
videos.summary_source_text:
04.11.26 - RIFT Training Day RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

videos.title: 90 dagar till längre drives…
videos.channel: Bättre & Enklare golf med Marcus Edblad PGA
videos.summary_source_text:
90 dagar till längre drives… Regelbunden men enkel träning i 90 dagar kommer göra dig snabbare och du kommer slå längre. Häng med på speed träning i höst och vinter.

#golf #golftips #golfswing 

0:00 Intro - Börja träna hastighet i vinter
1:00 Regelbundenhet är nyckeln till framgång. 

Nu finns det möjlighet att genom appen Skillest göra mig till din personliga tränare. Du hittar mig på denna länk: https://skillest.com/app/profile/marcus-edblad

Låt mig hjälpa dig finna bättre slag, bollträff, riktning och svinghastighet. Oavsett om du slår en wedge, järnklubba eller driver kan du med dina händer lära dig golfslag som du inte trodde var möjliga. Längre och rakare slag kräver alltid träning men något alla kan lära sig.  

Vare sig du kämpar med en slice eller en hook så har jag videos som kan guida till bättre golf. Är du nybörjare så kan du börja med min grönt kort eller nybörjarkurs.

Försök ersätta dåliga vanor med nya bättre vanor. Oavsett vilket loft eller skaft din klubba har så är det du som bestämmer vad som ska hända. Oavsett om det står callaway, ping, titleist eller taylor made på klubban så kan du slå bra slag.

Var noga med vad du tittar på. Det finns många duktiga instruktörer på nätet, några av mina favoriter är Mike Malaska, Mike Dunaway, Mike Austin.

Försök fokusera på grunderna i slaget bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår. Träna med fördel på en sak i taget. Tränar du din svinghastighet måste du tillåta att det går snett och tränar du raka slag kan du inte samtidigt svinga i max fart.

Ha tålamod och låt det ta sin tid, luras inte av genvägar som bara gör att du tappar fokus från det viktiga. Golf kommer alltid vara svårt men vi kan med träning se till att vi blir bättre för varje dag som går.

Titta mycket på golf på TV. Bryson Dechambeu, Dustin Johnson, Rory Mcilroy kan inspirera till längre slag och andra som Tiger Woods, Viktor Hovland, Ludvig Åberg och Phil Mickelson kan ge dig fantasi att skapa nya slag.

Träna styrketräning för hela kroppen för att må bra genom livet och skapa en effektiv maskin. Träna händer, handleder och armar för att skapa en effektiv release och mer svinghastighet.

Du kan finna inspiration i filmer som Happy Gilmore, Tin Cup eller Bagger Vance. Filmer som Rocky kan ge dig motivation att ta dig till gymet. Legender som Arnold Schwarzenegger, Sylvester Stallone eller Hulk Hogan kan få dig att vilja bli starkare och Moe Norman, Arnold Palmer, Ben Hogan, Sam Snead eller Jack Nicklaus kan inspirera dig att bli en bättre golfare. 

Ge aldrig upp i sökandet och träningen för att få bästa bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår.

Filmat med iPhone 17 och redigerat i iMovie på en Macbook. Regelbunden men enkel träning i 90 dagar kommer göra dig snabbare och du kommer slå längre. Häng med på speed träning i höst och vinter.

videos.title: Hindi - 04.11.26 - RIFT Presentation
videos.summary_source_text:
Hindi - 04.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

Andrew Novak joins after 1st PGA Tour win + FedExCup Fall updates | The Drop The Drop welcomes VidantaWorld Mexico Open winner Andrew Novak to the show, fresh off his victory over the weekend. Novak addresses his first individual win on the PGA Tour, establishing his place in the 2028 Championship Series, how his putter took over – and how he keeps up with the football scores while he’s out on the course. With 3 events remaining on the fall schedule, we examine the various bubbles in the FedExCup Fall standings and what it means for certain players as they seek status for 2027. And with the initial college football playoff rankings being released this week, The Drop came up with our own bracket for the top 12 college teams… if they were comprised of PGA Tour golfers.

Late-night junk food
Taking antihistamines or sleeping pills without understanding the risks
Sleeping with your cell phone next to you
Getting too little sleep

videos.title: What Really Happens When You Add One Clove and Ginger to Coffee? | Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
What Really Happens When You Add One Clove and Ginger to Coffee? | Dr. Mandell One clove in coffee is trending, but what happens when you add ginger? In this video, Dr. Mandell explains the plant compounds in clove and ginger and why researchers have studied ginger in relation to stomach movement and inflammation-related markers, and clove in relation to antioxidant defenses and metabolic health. He also explains what measurements such as CRP, blood sugar, HbA1c, and cholesterol tell researchers—and how to make this warm, aromatic coffee with one whole clove and a tiny pinch of ginger. The human studies discussed used measured ginger supplements or standardized clove extracts, so their findings don’t tell us what this particular coffee recipe will do. This is a flavorful way to explore two familiar spices and the science being done on them.

How to make it: Brew coffee as usual. Lightly crush one whole clove, add it to the hot coffee, and let it steep for about two minutes. Remove the clove, then stir in a tiny pinch of ground ginger. Start with a small amount so the spices complement the coffee.

PubMed research
- Wu KL et al. “Effects of ginger on gastric emptying and motility in healthy humans.” European Journal of Gastroenterology & Hepatology. 2008;20(5):436–440. PMID: 18403946. In a study of 24 healthy volunteers, researchers tested 1,200 mg of ginger in capsules and observed faster gastric emptying and more stomach contractions. The study did not find a significant difference in reported digestive symptoms.
- Morvaridzadeh M et al. “Effect of ginger (Zingiber officinale) on inflammatory markers: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.” Cytokine. 2020;135:155224. PMID: 32763761. This review combined 16 trials involving 1,010 participants. It reported changes in some inflammation-related markers after ginger supplementation; the studies varied considerably.
- A 30-day clove-extract pilot study in 13 volunteers examined pre-meal and after-meal blood sugar. It used 250 mg of a concentrated clove extract daily. Journal of Medicinal Food. 2019. PMID: 31064377. This was a small, open-label pilot—not a study of one clove in coffee.
The 12-week clove-extract study discussed in the video was published in Journal of Functional Foods in 2022 (volume 98, article 105273; DOI: 10.1016/j.jff.2022.105273). I couldn’t verify a PubMed PMID for that study, so I’ve listed it separately from the PubMed-indexed studies.

videos.title: GPT-6.2 Astra Just LEAKED After GPT-6.1 Went ROGUE! (Claude Mythos 5.5 Too)
videos.summary_source_text:
GPT-6.2 Astra Just LEAKED After GPT-6.1 Went ROGUE! (Claude Mythos 5.5 Too) Typeless Link: https://www.typeless.com/?via=1014

GPT-6.2 Astra appeared in OpenAI Codex usage data. Claude Mythos 5.5 surfaced in hidden code on Anthropic's own website. And Claude Fable 5.5 briefly appeared in Microsoft's Azure model catalog before disappearing.

Three potential AI model leaks. Two major AI companies. Zero official announcements.

But one suspicious detail in the Fable 5.5 listing raises serious questions about how much of this is actually real.

On November 1st, developers spotted an unexpected model identifier, gpt-6.2-astra, in their OpenAI Codex analytics. One screenshot showed 19.8% of an account's usage attributed to GPT-6.2 Astra, despite the interface displaying GPT-6 Astra.

Was OpenAI quietly testing its next flagship model? Or was this simply an internal alias, reporting error, or mislabeled version of an existing system?

The distinction matters, especially after reports that OpenAI cancelled GPT-6.1 Astra over safety concerns involving authorization boundaries and potentially deceptive behavior.

Meanwhile, Anthropic had its own mysterious developments.

There was just one problem.

Every specification matched Claude Fable 5.1 exactly.

Was this an accidental early listing, a placeholder, or simply incorrect catalog data?

Then came Claude Mythos 5.5.

References to the unreleased model reportedly appeared six times in hidden elements of Anthropic's official website, including page text and image descriptions. Unlike the Azure listing, these references originated from Anthropic's own web infrastructure.

But the visible page still identified Mythos 5.1.

That discovery becomes more interesting alongside Anthropic's recent cybersecurity research. The company disclosed that an unreleased Claude research model exploited a critical Linux vulnerability, progressing from a memory leak to root access in just 53 minutes.

Some observers suspect that model could be Mythos 5.5.

And the speculation doesn't stop there.

Developers have shared impressive AI-generated animations, Minecraft-style environments, interactive 3D worlds, and coding demonstrations allegedly created using unreleased models.

Some claim these results came from a single prompt.

videos.title: Grok 4.8: Elon Musk's 2.5 TRILLION Parameter AI Is Coming…
videos.summary_source_text:
Grok 4.8: Elon Musk's 2.5 TRILLION Parameter AI Is Coming… Try UNLIMITED SeeDance 2.5 on OpenArt: https://openart.ai/home?utm_source=yo...

Elon Musk says Grok 4.8 will have 2.5 TRILLION parameters, run on an entirely new C++ training stack, and be "incredibly useful." But more than seven weeks after Musk suggested pretraining was nearly complete, xAI's next flagship AI model still hasn't launched.

And now Musk says he doesn't care about benchmarks.

That's a fascinating position when OpenAI's GPT-5.6, Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1, and Google's Gemini 4 are already competing for developers. Especially when Grok 4.7 reportedly gained just TWO points on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index while more than doubling its average output tokens.

So is Grok 4.8 being built to outperform competitors on real-world tasks? Or is xAI managing expectations for a model that's struggling to catch up?

On September 13–14, Musk described Grok 4.8 as a 2.5-trillion-parameter model trained using a brand-new C and C++ software stack. Pretraining was supposedly finishing that week, with reinforcement learning to follow.

Then, on October 30, Musk acknowledged the delay and promised Grok 4.8 wouldn't disappoint.

But here's the problem: there's still no official Grok 4.8 model card, API pricing, independent benchmark, confirmed architecture, or context-window specification.

And the 2.5 trillion parameter figure? That's Musk's claim, not an independently verified specification.

We break down what's confirmed, what's claimed, and what's speculation.

First, there's the Grok 4.7 problem. According to reported Artificial Analysis results, its Intelligence Index improved from 44 to 46, while average output length increased from approximately 38,000 to 81,000 tokens. That raises an uncomfortable question: if a model costs less per token but uses twice as many tokens, how much are developers actually saving?

Then there's Grok 4.8's mysterious architecture.

A 2.5-trillion-parameter dense model would have enormous computational requirements. A mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture could activate only a fraction of those parameters per token, potentially improving inference efficiency.

But xAI hasn't confirmed which architecture Grok 4.8 uses.

We also examine Musk's claimed C++ training overhaul, the potential advantages over higher-level training infrastructure, and the debugging and scaling problems that could come with rebuilding critical software during a major training run.

Could that explain the delay? Possibly. Could reinforcement learning be responsible, especially after Grok 4.7's reported response-length penalty mistake? Also possible. But neither explanation has been confirmed.

Meanwhile, the competition isn't waiting.

GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna are targeting different price-performance tiers. Claude Fable 5.1 raises the flagship competition. Gemini 4 Argon offers roughly a million-token context window, while Google has announced Gemini 4 Carbon with limited initial access.

Grok 4.7 offers 500,000 tokens of context and API pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. Can Grok 4.8 preserve that value while delivering a meaningful improvement?

And what does Musk actually mean by "incredibly useful"?

We examine how Grok Bot, Grok Build, agent workflows, cost per completed task, independent testing, and real-world coding performance could provide a more meaningful answer than a single leaderboard score.

Because the biggest question isn't whether Grok 4.8 has 2.5 trillion parameters.

It's whether xAI can turn those parameters into better results, at a competitive price, before the market moves on.

Subscribe to BitBiased for independent analysis of OpenAI, xAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, AI models, and the technology shaping what's next.

Blood pressure and cholesterol aren’t necessarily the best predictors of longevity. One of the most important health markers is something most doctors aren’t even testing for: VO2 max.

VO2 max measures how efficiently your body uses oxygen during maximum physical exertion, making it an excellent biomarker for heart health, metabolic health, and longevity. It reflects your body’s health reserve and can help predict not only how long you will live but also your quality of life as you age.

One of the best ways to improve VO2 max is the Norwegian 4x4 workout.

How to do the Norwegian 4x4 workout on a bike or treadmill:
1. Warm up for 10 minutes.
2. Exercise at high intensity for 4 minutes, reaching 85 to 90% of your maximum heart rate.
3. Reduce the intensity significantly for 3 minutes.
4. Repeat the high-intensity and recovery intervals for a total of 4 rounds.

Aim for 1 to 2 Norwegian 4x4 workouts per week, depending on your age and fitness level. Zone 2 training and weight training should also be part of your exercise routine to help improve VO2 max and support long-term heart health.

Are old Supercars RUBBISH? V12 Lambo v 7-seat Volvo DRAG RACE! Are old supercars pointless?! 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-021026

Is this one of the weirdest line-ups we’ve ever had on the channel?

We’ve got our hands on one of the all-time great Lamborghinis - the Murciélago LP640. And it’s lining up against… a Volvo EX90?! 

You may think this race is completely pointless, pitting a 7-seat family SUV against a classic supercar. But these cars are actually more closely matched than you may think! Let’s take a closer look at the stats… 

Starting with the Lambo, it’s powered by a 6.5-litre naturally aspirated V12, which produces 640hp and 660Nm of torque. This power is sent to all four wheels via a 6-speed gearbox, and it tips the scales at 1,765kg. As of today, it’s worth about £500,000, and it was released way back in 2007. 

Then we come to the Volvo EX90. It’s an all-electric, family-friendly SUV, and it’s packing two electric motors which combine to produce 680hp and 870Nm. Given it has two motors, it comes with all-wheel drive, but it’s mighty heavy, weighing in at 2,725kg! It’s also a whole lot cheaper than the Lambo, costing £98,160. 

So how will this one play out? The Lambo weighs a tonne less than the Volvo, but will the extra power from the electric motors prove decisive? There’s only one way to find out for sure… LET’S RACE!

videos.title: 03.11.26 - RIFT Presentation
videos.summary_source_text:
03.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

videos.title: Hindi - 03.11.26 - RIFT Presentation
videos.summary_source_text:
Hindi - 03.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Walk for 10 minutes after dinner to help regulate blood sugar and improve circulation.
• Elevate your legs in the evening to help reduce fluid buildup.
• Follow a low-carb diet with intermittent fasting to address blood sugar and insulin resistance.

videos.title: Can This Spice Protect Your Memory as You Age?  Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
Can This Spice Protect Your Memory as You Age?  Dr. Mandell What if a common spice sitting in your kitchen could play a surprising role in protecting your brain as you age? Researchers are studying cinnamon for its potential effects on brain inflammation, memory, blood sugar regulation, insulin resistance, and even proteins associated with Alzheimer's disease. In this fascinating video, Dr. Alan Mandell explains how inflammation, oxidative stress, poor circulation, and blood sugar spikes can affect the delicate neurons responsible for memory, focus, and mental clarity. Discover why the hippocampus, your brain's important memory center, is especially sensitive to metabolic changes, and how cinnamon's natural polyphenols are being investigated for their antioxidant and neuroprotective properties. You'll also learn about the difference between Ceylon cinnamon and cassia cinnamon, why Ceylon is generally preferred for regular use, and simple ways to incorporate a small amount into your daily routine. Although cinnamon has not been proven to prevent or reverse memory loss or Alzheimer's disease, the emerging research offers fascinating insights into the relationship between nutrition, metabolism, and brain health. Sometimes the smallest daily habits can inspire the biggest changes in how we care for our health. Protect your brain, nourish your body, and remember that your health is one of your greatest gifts.

PubMed Research:

Nakhaee S, et al. (2024). Cinnamon and cognitive function: a systematic review of preclinical and clinical studies. Nutritional Neuroscience. PMID: 36652384.

Peterson DW, et al. (2009). Cinnamon extract inhibits tau aggregation associated with Alzheimer's disease in vitro. Journal of Alzheimer's Disease. PMID: 19433898.

Moridpour AH, et al. (2024). The effect of cinnamon supplementation on glycemic control in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus: An updated systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Phytotherapy Research. PMID: 37818728.

Elon Musk’s 10 Trillion Parameter Grok 5 — Is This AGI? Try UNLIMITED SeeDance 2.5 on OpenArt: https://openart.ai/home?utm_source=yo...

Elon Musk promised Grok 5 would be the smartest AI in the world by a significant margin. Three missed deadlines later, xAI still hasn't released it. Now, with just weeks left in 2026, the biggest question isn't whether Grok 5 can beat OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. It's whether Musk can deliver it at all.

The rumored specifications are extraordinary: 6 to 10 trillion parameters, a context window potentially exceeding 1 million tokens, native multimodal capabilities, and training on one of the world's largest AI supercomputers. Musk has even claimed Grok 5 has a 10% and rising chance of becoming AGI.

There's just one problem: almost none of those specifications have been officially confirmed.

In January 2026, xAI raised $20 billion and confirmed that Grok 5 was in training. Since then, no official Grok 5 model card, independent benchmark, pricing, or verified technical specifications have appeared.

Meanwhile, the competition hasn't waited.

OpenAI has moved forward with GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6.1 Terra. Anthropic has released Claude Fable 5 alongside its Claude 5.5 lineup. Google has advanced to Gemini 4. And xAI itself continues shipping Grok 4.x updates instead of its long-promised next-generation model.

So what's actually happening behind the scenes?

We trace Grok's evolution from its November 2023 debut through Grok 4.7, examining how xAI went from increasingly rapid releases to its longest gap between major model generations.

Then there's Colossus.

xAI's Memphis supercomputer has expanded beyond 220,000 NVIDIA GPUs, with reported plans for infrastructure approaching one million GPUs. Colossus 2 has reportedly reached gigawatt-scale power consumption, making Musk's AI infrastructure ambitions almost as significant as the models themselves.

But the most surprising development isn't the hardware.

In May 2026, xAI announced a compute partnership with Anthropic, allowing one of Musk's biggest AI competitors to run Claude models on Colossus-1.

Why would Elon Musk provide computing infrastructure to a direct competitor while Grok 5 remains unreleased?

That unusual arrangement raises important questions about xAI's strategy, available computing capacity, and what might actually be delaying its flagship model.

We also examine Musk's broader AI ecosystem, including Grok's integration with X and Tesla, the company's expanding voice AI products, and his speculative plans for orbital AI data centers involving SpaceX.

And what about the viral Grok 5 rumors?

Is it really a 6-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model? Could it have a 2-million-token context window? Is xAI privately testing it? Will it power Tesla Optimus robots? Could Grok 5 actually achieve artificial general intelligence?

We separate confirmed information from Musk's predictions and unverified speculation.

The video also investigates the controversies surrounding xAI, including environmental scrutiny of its Memphis infrastructure, reported emissions concerns, and previous Grok safety failures.

Finally, we explain how to evaluate Grok 5 when it launches.

A benchmark victory means little without understanding testing conditions, reasoning budgets, tool access, independent verification, and which competing models were actually evaluated.

Three scenarios. Seven major rumors. Four launch windows. And one missing AI model that could determine whether xAI's enormous infrastructure investment pays off.

The evidence tells a much more complicated story than the headlines.

We trace Grok's evolution from its November 2023 debut through Grok 4.7, examining how xAI went from increasingly rapid releases to its longest gap between major model generations.

Then there's Colossus.

xAI's Memphis supercomputer has expanded beyond 220,000 NVIDIA GPUs, with reported plans for infrastructure approaching one million GPUs. Colossus 2 has reportedly reached gigawatt-scale power consumption, making Musk's AI infrastructure ambitions almost as significant as the models themselves.

But the most surprising development isn't the hardware.

In May 2026, xAI announced a compute partnership with Anthropic, allowing one of Musk's biggest AI competitors to run Claude models on Colossus-1.

Why would Elon Musk provide computing infrastructure to a direct competitor while Grok 5 remains unreleased?

That unusual arrangement raises important questions about xAI's strategy, available computing capacity, and what might actually be delaying its flagship model.

We also examine Musk's broader AI ecosystem, including Grok's integration with X and Tesla, the company's expanding voice AI products, and his speculative plans for orbital AI data centers involving SpaceX.

And what about the viral Grok 5 rumors?

Is it really a 6-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model? Could it have a 2-million-token context window? Is xAI privately testing it? Will it power Tesla Optimus robots? Could Grok 5 actually achieve artificial general intelligence?

We separate confirmed information from Musk's predictions and unverified speculation.

The video also investigates the controversies surrounding xAI, including environmental scrutiny of its Memphis infrastructure, reported emissions concerns, and previous Grok safety failures.

Finally, we explain how to evaluate Grok 5 when it launches.

A benchmark victory means little without understanding testing conditions, reasoning budgets, tool access, independent verification, and which competing models were actually evaluated.

Could Grok 5 simply match today's frontier models? Could it become a genuine competitor to GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5, and Gemini 4? Or could Musk deliver the breakthrough he's been promising?

Three scenarios. Seven major rumors. Four launch windows. And one missing AI model that could determine whether xAI's enormous infrastructure investment pays off.

The evidence tells a much more complicated story than the headlines.

7 Warning Signs of a Slow Thyroid You Need to Know A slow thyroid can affect numerous aspects of your health, but many doctors miss the signs.

Watch the FULL video here: ▶️https://youtu.be/mogBUWRmraE

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/3VpP83N

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements.

Here are 7 common symptoms of hypothyroidism you may not have realized are related to your thyroid:

1. Eyebrow changes
Disappearing outer thirds of your eyebrows? Thyroid hormones power your hair follicles, so hair loss in this area can signal a thyroid issue.

2. High cholesterol levels
High cholesterol often leads to immediate medication prescriptions. But did you know a slow thyroid can cause this imbalance? Addressing it may normalize your cholesterol levels.

3. Puffy face
Waking up with facial puffiness? This could indicate your thyroid is trapping water beneath the skin, a common symptom of thyroid dysfunction.

4. Carpal tunnel syndrome
Fluid accumulation around the median nerve can be a result of hypothyroidism, and swelling can lead to carpal tunnel syndrome.

5. Mood changes
Feeling depressed or anxious? Over 50% of those with a slow thyroid experience mood disorders. Thyroid hormones are essential for energy production in your brain.

6. Persistent headaches
Thyroid issues can cause muscle tightness in your neck. This tension may lead to headaches or migraines due to locked-up muscles.

7. Low body temperature
Use a thermometer to monitor your morning temperature. If it’s below 97.8°F, consider a slow thyroid as a possible cause.

videos.title: Chicken over Fries med Caj P. Sriracha Mayo [Recept]
videos.summary_source_text:
Chicken over Fries med Caj P. Sriracha Mayo [Recept] Vår senaste obsession innehåller krispiga pommes, friterad kyckling och massor av god sås. Burgerdudes Chicken over Fries är enkel att svänga ihop med Caj P. Sriracha Mayo, som ger både krämighet och skön hetta. Ett baconregn ger extra sälta och krisp, och vi toppar med chili och allas favorit koriander. Ja, vi vet att åsikterna går isär där. Du kan enkelt köpa både pommes och kyckling från en restaurang och ta med dig, så behöver du bara fixa tillbehören och bygga ihop allt på tallriken.

🔥 Burgerdudes Chicken over Fries
2 portioner / 15 min

Du behöver:
1 stor portion pommes frites, ca 300 gram
3 bitar benfri friterad kyckling cirka 250 gram
4 skivor bacon
Caj P. Sriracha Mayo
Färsk koriander
Röd chili

Gör så här:

1.) Stek baconet krispigt och låt det rinna av på hushållspapper. Du kan hacka det eller smula det med händerna.
2.) Hacka koriandern grovt och skiva den röda chilin tunt.
3.) Dela den friterade kycklingen i mindre bitar.
4.) Lägg de varma pommesen på en tallrik och fördela kycklingen ovanpå.
5.) Ringla över rikligt med Caj P. Sriracha Mayo så att både kycklingen och pommesen täcks med sås.
6.) Avsluta med ett baconregn, följt av koriander och röd chili.

videos.title: 02.11.26 - RIFT Education Day
videos.summary_source_text:
02.11.26 - RIFT Education Day RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

Avalanche Course Correct After Early Deficit, Grab Road Win Over Blackhawks Colorado Avalanche snap road woes with a commanding 5-2 victory over the Chicago Blackhawks. After an early deficit and a controversial goalie interference call, key performances from Nazem Kadri and Jaden Schwartz propelled the Avs to rally back—Kadri’s acrobatic “Superman” goal leading the charge. Is this the turning point for Colorado's struggles away from Ball Arena?

The conversation focused on Gabe Landeskog’s evolving leadership, Mackenzie Blackwood’s steady presence in net, and the impressive growth of TJ Hughes in the absence of coveted first-round picks. A key theme that emerged was inconsistency in NHL goalie interference calls, sparking heated reactions around league officiating. The discussion explored special teams' improvement, Nathan MacKinnon’s turnover concerns, and speculation on which Avs player will notch the season’s elusive first hat trick. videos.title: Hindi - 02.11.26 - RIFT Presentation
videos.summary_source_text:
Hindi - 02.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

How to Get RID of Skin Tags (& Stop Them For Good) Skin tags can keep coming back when you don’t address the underlying cause. Multiple skin tags are strongly associated with insulin resistance and metabolic syndrome, making high insulin levels an important factor to consider.

Watch the FULL video here: https://youtu.be/UrECG94DKkE

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4z02wd4

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements.   

To get rid of skin tags and help prevent them from returning, focus on two things: removing the existing skin tags and lowering insulin levels.

Povidone-iodine can be applied directly to the skin tag, but preventing new skin tags means addressing high insulin levels. Cutting out sugars and starches, avoiding frequent snacking, and practicing intermittent fasting can help lower insulin and address the underlying cause.

Checking your fasting insulin levels can also help you identify insulin resistance, even when your blood sugar appears normal.

videos.title: GPT Makes 3 Scientific Discoveries, Grok BEATS ChatGPT, AI Analyzes Millions of Brain Cells: AI NEWS
videos.summary_source_text:
GPT Makes 3 Scientific Discoveries, Grok BEATS ChatGPT, AI Analyzes Millions of Brain Cells: AI NEWS Ottokit Link: https://ottokit.com/?aff=14ca2272

OpenAI just deployed 1,946 AI agents to analyze a massive mouse brain dataset in 32 minutes. The company also claims its AI models generated formal proofs of major unsolved problems in mathematics and computer science. Meanwhile, Elon Musk's xAI says Grok Voice 3.0 has surpassed ChatGPT's voice AI.

Three major AI breakthroughs. Three sets of impressive numbers. But when you examine the evidence, the story gets considerably more complicated.

OpenAI's GPT-Rosalind system used 1,946 parallel AI agents to analyze a whole-brain Perturb-seq dataset from a 2026 study by Sun and colleagues. Each agent examined a different gene perturbation, investigated cellular changes, reviewed scientific literature, and generated research hypotheses.

According to OpenAI, the entire analysis took just 32 minutes, compared with months of estimated human research time. The multi-agent system referenced more than 700 scientific sources, while a single-agent approach cited only 11.

One particularly interesting finding involved DCTN1, cholesterol-related genes, and potential connections to Parkinson's disease research.

And an existence result involving quantum chromodynamics and related physical theories.

OpenAI released machine-checkable formal proofs using Lean, a mathematical proof assistant that verifies logical steps.

But here's the critical catch.

A proof passing Lean verification doesn't automatically establish that the formalized statement perfectly represents the original mathematical conjecture. Independent mathematicians still need to examine whether the AI actually proved what OpenAI claims.

These results remain under expert scrutiny, and the physics claim has not been fully published.

If the proofs survive independent verification, the implications for mathematics, computer science, and AI-assisted discovery could be enormous. If they don't, the failures could reveal important limitations in AI-generated mathematical reasoning.

Meanwhile, xAI has entered another major competition with OpenAI: real-time voice AI.

Grok Voice 3.0, released October 14, reportedly outperformed OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 on the Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech Index.

The independent benchmark numbers tell an interesting story:

Grok Voice 3.0: 86.9
GPT-Live-1 (medium): 83.2

Grok also demonstrated significantly faster response times:

Grok Voice 3.0: 0.81 seconds to first audio
GPT-Live-1: 1.34 seconds

That's approximately 40% less waiting before Grok starts responding.

Grok also showed slightly lower costs per completed task on Big Bench Audio, at 2.5 cents compared with 3 cents for GPT-Live-1.

But the benchmark measuring actual task completion tells a different story.

On tau-Voice, which evaluates whether AI agents can successfully resolve multi-step customer service problems:

GPT-Live-1: 74.5%
Grok Voice 3.0: 71.6%

So Grok leads the overall voice benchmark, but ChatGPT performs better on the test measuring whether customer problems actually get solved.

And this competition is already moving beyond benchmarks.

According to reporting from Business Insider, Grok is handling Starlink customer support calls. xAI reports approximately 20,000 calls daily, with around 70% resolved without human intervention.

That's a significant real-world deployment, but it also means roughly 30% of calls still require human assistance.

Privacy, reliability, complex customer interactions, and the risks of AI making confident mistakes remain important unanswered questions.

These three developments reveal something important about the current state of artificial intelligence.

AI agents can dramatically accelerate research, but generating hypotheses isn't the same as proving discoveries.

AI can produce formally verified mathematical arguments, but verification still depends on whether the formal statements match the original problems.

And AI voice assistants can outperform competitors on headline benchmarks while falling behind on the practical tasks businesses actually care about.

The biggest question isn't simply which company has the most impressive announcement.

It's which results survive independent verification, real-world testing, and human scrutiny.

Subscribe to BitBiased for evidence-driven coverage of OpenAI, ChatGPT, xAI, Grok, AI agents, scientific breakthroughs, and the technologies shaping the future.

OpenAI's GPT-Rosalind system used 1,946 parallel AI agents to analyze a whole-brain Perturb-seq dataset from a 2026 study by Sun and colleagues. Each agent examined a different gene perturbation, investigated cellular changes, reviewed scientific literature, and generated research hypotheses.

According to OpenAI, the entire analysis took just 32 minutes, compared with months of estimated human research time. The multi-agent system referenced more than 700 scientific sources, while a single-agent approach cited only 11.

One particularly interesting finding involved DCTN1, cholesterol-related genes, and potential connections to Parkinson's disease research.

And an existence result involving quantum chromodynamics and related physical theories.

OpenAI released machine-checkable formal proofs using Lean, a mathematical proof assistant that verifies logical steps.

But here's the critical catch.

A proof passing Lean verification doesn't automatically establish that the formalized statement perfectly represents the original mathematical conjecture. Independent mathematicians still need to examine whether the AI actually proved what OpenAI claims.

These results remain under expert scrutiny, and the physics claim has not been fully published.

If the proofs survive independent verification, the implications for mathematics, computer science, and AI-assisted discovery could be enormous. If they don't, the failures could reveal important limitations in AI-generated mathematical reasoning.

Meanwhile, xAI has entered another major competition with OpenAI: real-time voice AI.

Grok Voice 3.0, released October 14, reportedly outperformed OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 on the Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech Index.

The independent benchmark numbers tell an interesting story:

Grok Voice 3.0: 86.9
GPT-Live-1 (medium): 83.2

Grok also demonstrated significantly faster response times:

Grok Voice 3.0: 0.81 seconds to first audio
GPT-Live-1: 1.34 seconds

That's approximately 40% less waiting before Grok starts responding.

Grok also showed slightly lower costs per completed task on Big Bench Audio, at 2.5 cents compared with 3 cents for GPT-Live-1.

But the benchmark measuring actual task completion tells a different story.

On tau-Voice, which evaluates whether AI agents can successfully resolve multi-step customer service problems:

GPT-Live-1: 74.5%
Grok Voice 3.0: 71.6%

So Grok leads the overall voice benchmark, but ChatGPT performs better on the test measuring whether customer problems actually get solved.

And this competition is already moving beyond benchmarks.

According to reporting from Business Insider, Grok is handling Starlink customer support calls. xAI reports approximately 20,000 calls daily, with around 70% resolved without human intervention.

That's a significant real-world deployment, but it also means roughly 30% of calls still require human assistance.

Privacy, reliability, complex customer interactions, and the risks of AI making confident mistakes remain important unanswered questions.

These three developments reveal something important about the current state of artificial intelligence.

AI agents can dramatically accelerate research, but generating hypotheses isn't the same as proving discoveries.

AI can produce formally verified mathematical arguments, but verification still depends on whether the formal statements match the original problems.

And AI voice assistants can outperform competitors on headline benchmarks while falling behind on the practical tasks businesses actually care about.

The biggest question isn't simply which company has the most impressive announcement.

It's which results survive independent verification, real-world testing, and human scrutiny.

videos.title: Give Me 23 Minutes, I’ll Give You 10,000 Hours of ChatGPT Knowledge
videos.summary_source_text:
Give Me 23 Minutes, I’ll Give You 10,000 Hours of ChatGPT Knowledge GPT-6 isn't just a smarter chatbot anymore. It can build interactive tools, research complex questions, analyze spreadsheets, generate images, remember your projects, and even complete tasks while you're away. But most people are still using ChatGPT like a search engine.

And here's the surprising part: OpenAI reports that GPT-6.1 Terra scored 50.3% on its Agents' Last Exam benchmark, compared to 21.5% for GPT-5.6 Terra. That's more than double the previous score. But there's a major catch behind those numbers, and understanding it could completely change how you use GPT-6.

This is your complete GPT-6 and ChatGPT masterclass in roughly 23 minutes. From choosing the right thinking level to building an automated research-to-presentation workflow, we're breaking down the features, settings, prompts, and limitations that actually matter.

First, there's the GPT-6 model family. Astra, Sol, Luna, and GPT-6.1 Terra aren't interchangeable. Neither are Instant, Medium, High, and Extra High thinking modes. We'll explain what each setting is designed for, how reasoning effort affects performance, and why the most powerful model isn't always the smartest choice for everyday work.

Then there's Intelligent UI, one of GPT-6's most interesting features. Instead of asking ChatGPT how to create a calculator, you can ask it to build an interactive one directly in your conversation. We're talking working bill splitters, adjustable charts, interactive learning tools, and custom interfaces without traditional coding.

But building tools is only the beginning.

Deep Research can investigate complicated questions, browse sources, and produce detailed reports with citations. We'll show you how to structure research prompts, verify sources, identify weak claims, and avoid blindly trusting AI-generated reports.

Next, we'll upload messy spreadsheets into ChatGPT's Data Analysis tool. You'll learn how to identify duplicates, detect missing values, calculate revenue, create interactive charts, and verify calculations using Python. No advanced Excel knowledge required.

We'll also explore ChatGPT Images 2.5, including image editing, sketch-based creation, and targeted changes using comments. Plus, you'll see how ChatGPT Voice can become a practical interview coach, presentation partner, or personal learning assistant.

Then we get into the features that make ChatGPT genuinely useful over time: Memory, Custom Instructions, and Projects.

Learn how to organize your files, create project-specific instructions, control what ChatGPT remembers, and build dedicated workspaces that maintain context across conversations.

And that's where ChatGPT Work enters the picture.

Instead of manually checking emails, preparing reports, or repeating routine tasks, ChatGPT Work can operate across connected apps and handle multi-step workflows. We'll explore scheduled tasks, Gmail automation, draft replies, agent permissions, and why human approval still matters.

Finally, we're connecting everything into one complete workflow:

Deep Research → Source Verification → Data Analysis → ChatGPT Projects → Finished Presentation.

You'll see how these tools work together to turn scattered information into a structured, evidence-backed six-slide decision deck.

But there are limitations worth understanding. AI research can still hallucinate. Spreadsheet analysis can use incorrect methods. Model access depends on your subscription. And even OpenAI's documentation can contain conflicting information.

The real advantage of GPT-6 isn't simply getting better answers. It's knowing how to combine the right tools, provide precise instructions, verify the results, and automate the repetitive work.

Whether you're a beginner learning ChatGPT, a creator building AI workflows, a student doing research, or a professional looking to save hours every week, this guide gives you practical prompts and techniques you can start using immediately.

Watch until the end for the complete GPT-6 workflow and the mistakes that can quietly undermine your results.

videos.summary_source_text:
Hybrids Are NOT Easier To Hit Than Long Irons (Here's Why) Struggling to decide between a long iron or hybrid in your bag? In this video, we break down the real data behind how to hit long irons versus how to hit hybrids, and why the standard advice you've been told is completely backward.

Most golfers assume a hybrid is automatically easier to hit, but when you look at the launch monitor numbers, the club tech tells a very different story. We test identical 18-degree heads—the Srixon ZXi utility driving iron versus the Srixon ZXi hybrid—to see how dynamic loft, angle of attack, center of gravity, and gear effect actually change how you deliver the club at impact.

Whether you tend to hit down on your irons with a steeper angle of attack or prefer sweeping fairway woods, this breakdown will help you figure out the exact club you should be gaming to keep the ball on the planet and hit more greens.

What 14 Days of Potassium Can Do to Your Body Getting enough potassium every day for 14 days can improve blood pressure, muscle function, energy, and fluid balance. Potassium is essential for the sodium-potassium pumps that power your cells and help maintain a healthy heartbeat.

Watch the FULL video here: ▶️https://youtu.be/HyzNnxplWIA

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4z7vQPU

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements.  

Here’s how your body can respond over two weeks:

• Days 1 to 3: Blood pressure starts to decrease, sometimes by 5 to 10 points
• Days 4 to 7: Muscle cramps begin to improve, along with sleep quality
• Days 8 to 10: Energy levels increase as your sodium-potassium pumps function more efficiently
• Days 11 to 14: Heart rhythm, palpitations, and fluid retention may improve, reducing puffiness and swelling

Your body needs around 4700 mg of potassium daily, yet many people don’t get enough to support these essential functions.

Fat shots, thin shots, and irons that never feel compressed often come from a left shoulder that stays too far back in the downswing, while many golfers do the opposite with driver. A recent student of Eric Cogorno's had both patterns, and the Swing Coach app showed his left shoulder well behind his ankle line with irons and well past it with driver. Eric's iron swing tips show how to hit irons by getting the left shoulder to the wall like in Adam Scott's golf swing while keeping the shoulders slightly closed, and his driver swing tips show how Justin Thomas keeps the left shoulder back so you can hit up on the ball. These golf swing tips also cover how to hit fairway woods and long irons, with simple golf tips for how far forward your left shoulder goes with every club. If you leave this video without trying the club across the shoulders drill, you're leaving ball-first, compressed iron shots on the table.

The all-new Audi A6 Allroad is here! 

It’s the fifth iteration of the A6 Allroad, and Mat’s about to put this one through its paces to see if it has what it takes to stack up against its predecessors. What’s more, he’ll also see how the practicality compares to some of the latest Audi estates and SUVs available today. 

But first up, let’s check out the design… 

Up front, the A6 Allroad sports a few design differences from the regular A6. It’s equipped with an all-new lower bumper, along with a unique and different grille design. There are also additional vents in the lower bumper to help airflow through to the wheels. Along the side, there are widened wheel arches at the front and back, coupled with black cladding on the surrounds and on the sills - you’ll also find black satin roof bars on the top. At the back, once again there’s a new bumper, coupled with some 100% real exhaust tips! 

On the inside, the design language mirrors any recent new Audi release. There’s a large swooping digital dial and infotainment screen, coupled with a passenger screen sitting across the remainder of the dash. There are soft-touch and Alcantara materials along the dash, although reach lower down and you’ll find some scratchy black plastics. The A6 Allroad is fitted with comfortable, figure-hugging sports seats, and there’s a decent enough amount of storage in the cabin. 

There are two engine choices available for the A6 Allroad. The car we have here is equipped with the 3-litre V6 turbo diesel, and this delivers 299hp and 580Nm to all four wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch. You can also choose a 2-litre 4-cylinder plug-in hybrid, and although it comes with a higher power output of 367hp, we think the diesel is the better choice of the two. 

So it sounds like a great car, right? Well, of course, it doesn’t come cheap. The new A6 Allroad starts from £69,700, but for the car we have here in this video, with lots of options added? You’re looking at north of £90,300! So is it worth it? Let us know what you think in the comments!

Up front, the A6 Allroad sports a few design differences from the regular A6. It’s equipped with an all-new lower bumper, along with a unique and different grille design. There are also additional vents in the lower bumper to help airflow through to the wheels. Along the side, there are widened wheel arches at the front and back, coupled with black cladding on the surrounds and on the sills - you’ll also find black satin roof bars on the top. At the back, once again there’s a new bumper, coupled with some 100% real exhaust tips! 

On the inside, the design language mirrors any recent new Audi release. There’s a large swooping digital dial and infotainment screen, coupled with a passenger screen sitting across the remainder of the dash. There are soft-touch and Alcantara materials along the dash, although reach lower down and you’ll find some scratchy black plastics. The A6 Allroad is fitted with comfortable, figure-hugging sports seats, and there’s a decent enough amount of storage in the cabin. 

There are two engine choices available for the A6 Allroad. The car we have here is equipped with the 3-litre V6 turbo diesel, and this delivers 299hp and 580Nm to all four wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch. You can also choose a 2-litre 4-cylinder plug-in hybrid, and although it comes with a higher power output of 367hp, we think the diesel is the better choice of the two. 

So it sounds like a great car, right? Well, of course, it doesn’t come cheap. The new A6 Allroad starts from £69,700, but for the car we have here in this video, with lots of options added? You’re looking at north of £90,300! So is it worth it? Let us know what you think in the comments!

Project Suncatcher marks a first for Google's data center chips, but its real goal is far bigger: solar-powered AI data centers built from laser-linked satellites. Meanwhile, Nvidia already has chips in orbit, and Google faces massive challenges with heat, radiation, and launch costs.

Google's Gemma 4 sends its first reply from orbit on a data center TPU.

Google's satellite carries 4 TPUs, but only 1 runs for 20 minutes at a time.

Google proposes 81 satellites connected by lasers to build huge AI clusters above Earth.

AI computing could eventually move beyond Earth, tapping near-constant sunlight to power satellite networks. But cooling chips in a vacuum, surviving radiation, keeping satellites connected, and launching everything cheaply could make the whole idea impractical.

The 7 Healthiest Foods You Need in Your Diet Discover the 7 healthiest foods you should include in your diet to support better nutrition, gut health, heart health, and overall wellness. These nutrient-dense foods provide essential vitamins, minerals, healthy fats, protein, and other beneficial nutrients that help your body function at its best.

Watch the FULL video here: ▶️https://youtu.be/fJWPp1EBpYg

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4dRHNk2

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements.

In this video, we explore seven powerful foods that can help you build a healthier, more balanced diet:

1. Raw Sauerkraut – A fermented food containing beneficial bacteria that may support gut health and healthy digestion.

2. Arugula – A nutrient-rich leafy green packed with vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants to support overall health.

3. Wild-Caught Salmon – An excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids and high-quality protein to support heart health and brain function.

4. Cod Liver – A nutrient-dense food containing vitamins A and D, along with beneficial omega-3 fatty acids.

5. Grass-Fed Ground Beef – Provides high-quality protein, vitamin B12, iron, zinc, and other essential nutrients.

6. Brazil Nuts – One of the richest dietary sources of selenium, an essential mineral that supports thyroid function and antioxidant defenses. Just a small amount can provide plenty of selenium.

7. Extra Virgin Olive Oil – Rich in monounsaturated fats and antioxidant compounds that can support cardiovascular health as part of a balanced diet.

WHY THESE 7 HEALTHY FOODS MATTER

Choosing nutrient-dense whole foods is an important step toward improving your daily nutrition. From fermented foods for gut health to omega-3-rich fish, leafy greens, quality protein, selenium-rich nuts, and healthy fats, these foods offer a variety of nutrients your body needs.

Which of these seven foods do you eat regularly? Let us know in the comments!

👍 Like this video if you found it helpful, share it with someone who wants to improve their diet, and subscribe for more videos on nutrition, healthy eating, gut health, and natural wellness.
